callbackurl.description: URL that will be called once the flow session is complete.

clienttrackingid.description: The client tracking id of the run

connectionid.description: The id of the connection used in the Desktop Flow run.

correlationid.description: Unique identifier used to correlate between multiple SDK requests and flow executions.

createdon.description: Date and time when the record was created.

errorcode.description: Error code describing the failure in flow session execution.

errordetails.description: Details of the failure in flow session execution.

errorinnererror.description: Specific information about the failure in flow session execution.

errormessage.description: Message describing the failure in flow session execution.

gateway.description: The name of the gateway used.

importsequencenumber.description: Sequence number of the import that created this record.

inputs.description: Inputs provided for the flow session execution.

machinepercentcpuusage.description: The percentage of CPU utilization by the machine

machinepercentramusage.description: The percentage of RAM utilization by the machine

machineramusage.description: The machine RAM usage in Mo

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the record was modified.

name.description: The name of the custom entity.

outputs.description: Outputs generated by the flow session execution.

overriddencreatedon.description: Date and time that the record was migrated.

parentcloudflowrunsequenceid.description: The sequence id of the parent cloud flow run, only used when the Desktop Flow was run by a cloud flow.

parentworkflowid.description: Id of the parent workflow, cloud flow or desktop flow.

_owningbusinessunit_value.description: Unique identifier for the business unit that owns the record
